target: a synthetic CSM resume, the candidate's own fact notes, and a Senior CSM job ad
prompt: Tailor my resume (resume.md) to job.md. My real numbers are in notes.md; use only those. Save the new resume as resume-ledgerline.md and give me a short summary of what you changed.
rubric: Rewrites bullets as action + result using only the facts in notes.md (64 accounts, ~£2.1M ARR, churn 14%→9%, onboarding 19→11 days)
Does not over-claim: the churn drop is shared with a pricing change, mentoring is not management, SQL stays basic/learning
Handles the 2021 gap honestly (carer, SQL course)
Places the job's keywords (Gainsight, Looker, SQL, onboarding, time-to-value, retention) where they are true
Replaces the cliché summary with a specific one
Invents no employer, title, date or number
